atoms.a: Mary cuts a slice of pizza. The slice is 45°. The remaining pizza now forms an angle. Calculate the degrees of this angle.

instruction.text: Now match the parts of the pizza to the correct angle.

hint.text: In total, 90° have now been taken from the pizza.

atoms.a: Mary’s brother then takes a slice of 45° from the remaining pizza. This creates a new angle in the remaining pizza. Calculate the degrees of this angle.

instruction.text: Now match the parts of the pizza to the correct angle.

hint.text: In total, 135° have now been taken from the pizza.
